endpoints.description: Gemini AI Neural Threat Audit Endpoint

remediations.title: Enable Defender PUA Protection
remediations.description: Blocks adware, coin-miners, and unwanted bundleware

remediations.title: Rollback Defender PUA Protection
remediations.description: Reverts PUA protection to standard disabled state

remediations.title: Disable SMBv1 & Require SMB Signing
remediations.description: Stops EternalBlue and NTLM relay lateral movements

remediations.title: Enable LSA RunAsPPL Protection
remediations.description: Hardens LSASS against Mimikatz credential dumping

remediations.title: Disable LLMNR Multicast Spoofing
remediations.description: Blocks Responder and LLMNR/NBT-NS rogue poisoners on LAN

remediations.title: Update Defender Antivirus Signatures
remediations.description: Pulls the latest threat intelligence signatures directly from Microsoft

envVars.name: PORT
envVars.description: TCP port for the Mission Control HTTP and SSE server (Default: 3000)

envVars.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
envVars.description: Google Gemini API key for neural threat analysis (Optional, can also be provided in UI)

envVars.name: GEMINI_MODEL
envVars.description: Google Gemini model tag for threat auditing (Default: gemini-2.5-flash)

envVars.name: AUTO_LAUNCH
envVars.description: Auto-launch default browser on startup (Set 'false' to disable)

envVars.name: NO_BROWSER
envVars.description: Alternative flag to inhibit browser auto-launching (Set '1' to disable)

envVars.name: CI
envVars.description: CI environment flag (Inhibits browser auto-launch when set)

envVars.name: SCRUB_TELEMETRY
envVars.description: Toggle zero-leak telemetry scrubber (Set 'false' to bypass redaction; Default: true)

envVars.name: USERNAME
envVars.description: Windows current operator username (Scrubbed in outbound telemetry)

envVars.name: USERPROFILE
envVars.description: Windows user profile directory (Scrubbed in outbound telemetry)
